newsitem.title: JAPAN: Foreigners 96/97 yen bond purchases at record high.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners 96/97 yen bond purchases at record high.

text.p: Foreign investors' net buying of yen bonds reached a record high of 3.4721 trillion yen in the fiscal 1996/97 year ended March 31, up sharply from 199.6 billion yen in the previous year, an official at the Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Wednesday.
The official told reporters that foreigners bought yen bonds despite the fact that long-term yen interest rates renewed record lows during the year.
This indicated that foreign investors needed to boost their yen bond holdings in order to actively engage in leveraged or arbitrage transactions, he said.
The official said that gross buying of Japanese stocks also hit a record high of 26.9720 trillion yen in 1996/97, compared with 24.3126 trillion yen in the previous fiscal year.
